arxiv-2005-10079.title: Towards a Generalized Approach to Nonlocal Elasticity via Fractional-Order Mechanics
arxiv-2005-10079.creator: Sansit Patnaik, Sai Sidhardh, Fabio Semperlotti
arxiv-2005-10079.description: Abstract This study presents a fractional-order continuum mechanics approach that allows combining selected characteristics of nonlocal elasticity, typical of classical integral and gradient formulations, under a single frame-invariant framework. The resulting generalized theory is capable of capturing both stiffening and softening effects and it is not subject to the inconsistencies often observed under selected external loads and boundary conditions.

arxiv-2012-04610.title: Quantum error correction thresholds for the universal Fibonacci Turaev-Viro code
arxiv-2012-04610.creator: Alexis Schotte, Guanyu Zhu, Lander Burgelman, Frank Verstraete
arxiv-2012-04610.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Alexis Schotte, Guanyu Zhu, Lander Burgelman, Frank Verstraete. We consider a two-dimensional quantum memory of qubits on a torus which encode the extended Fibonacci string-net code, and devise strategies for error correction when those qubits are subjected to depolarizing noise. Building on the concept of tube algebras, we construct a set of measurements and of quantum gates which map arbitrary qubit errors to the string-net subspace and allow for the characterization of the resulting error syndrome in terms of doubled Fibonacci anyons.

arxiv-2103-16225.title: Parameter estimation bias from overlapping binary black hole events in second generation interferometers
arxiv-2103-16225.creator: Philip Relton, Vivien Raymond
arxiv-2103-16225.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Philip Relton, Vivien Raymond. Since the initial detection of gravitational waves in 2015, over 50 candidate events have been reported by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA collaboration. As the current generation of detectors move toward their design sensitivity, the rate of these detections will increase. The next generation of detectors are likely to have high enough sensitivities that multiple merging binaries will be visible at the same time.

arxiv-2104-14246.title: Legio: Fault Resiliency for Embarrassingly Parallel MPI Applications
arxiv-2104-14246.creator: Roberto Rocco, Davide Gadioli, and Gianluca Palermo
arxiv-2104-14246.description: Abstract Due to the increasing size of HPC machines, the fault presence is becoming an eventuality that applications must face. Natively, MPI provides no support for the execution past the detection of a fault, and this is becoming more and more constraining.

arxiv-2107-13767.title: Edge computing in 5G cellular networks for real-time analysis of electrocardiography recorded with wearable textile sensors
arxiv-2107-13767.creator: Nicolai Spicher, Member, IEEE, Arne Klingenberg, Student Member, IEEE, Valentin Purrucker, Thomas M. Deserno, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2107-13767.description: Abstract Fifth-generation (5G) cellular networks promise higher data rates, lower latency, and large numbers of interconnected devices. Thereby, 5G will provide important steps towards unlocking the full potential of the Internet of Things (IoT). In this work, we propose a lightweight IoT platform for continuous vital sign analysis.

arxiv-2112-06598.title: WECHSEL: Effective initialization of subword embeddings for cross-lingual transfer of monolingual language models
arxiv-2112-06598.creator: Benjamin Minixhofer, Fabian Paischer, Navid Rekabsaz
arxiv-2112-06598.description: Abstract Large pretrained language models (LMs) have become the central building block of many NLP applications. Training these models requires ever more computational resources and most of the existing models are trained on English text only. It is exceedingly expensive to train these models in other languages.

arxiv-2208-08161.title: KAM - a Kernel Attention Module for Emotion Classification with EEG Data
arxiv-2208-08161.creator: Dongyang Kuang, Craig Michoski
arxiv-2208-08161.description: Abstract In this work, a kernel attention module is presented for the task of EEG-based emotion classification with neural networks. The proposed module utilizes a self-attention mechanism by performing a kernel trick, demanding significantly fewer trainable parameters and computations than standard attention modules.

arxiv-2302-07747.title: Polar Zonohedra Edge-Unfold to Nets
arxiv-2302-07747.creator: Joseph O’Rourke
arxiv-2302-07747.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Joseph O’Rourke. This note proves that every polar zonohedron has an edge-unfolding to a non-overlapping net. 1 Introduction What has become known as Dürer’s Problem [ O’R13 ] asks whether or not every convex polyhedron P has an edge-unfolding—a spanning tree of the 1 -skeleton which when cut, unfolds the surface of P to a planar simple polygon known as a net . A key requirement is that a net does not self-overlap.

arxiv-2309-05885.creator: Yuyan Bao, Guannan Wei, Oliver Bračevac, Tiark Rompf
arxiv-2309-05885.description: Abstract . Reachability types are a recent proposal to bring Rust-style reasoning about memory properties to higher-level languages. While key type soundness results for reachability types have been established using syntactic techniques in prior work, stronger metatheoretic properties have so far been unexplored.

arxiv-2507-14599.title: Influence of the external electromagnetic field on the properties of the Novikov-Thorne accretion disk in Kerr spacetime
arxiv-2507-14599.creator: Shiyang Hu 1, Yuxiang Zuo 1, Dan Li 1, Chen Deng 2
arxiv-2507-14599.description: Abstract The Novikov-Thorne accretion disk model is widely employed in astrophysics, yet computing its blackbody spectrum theoretically requires analytical expressions for the orbital parameters—specific energy, angular momentum, and angular velocity—of the constituent timelike particles, a task extremely challenging in non-integrable curved spacetimes.

arxiv-2509-11752.title: A Fully Open and Generalizable Foundation Model for Ultrasound Clinical Applications
arxiv-2509-11752.creator: Hongyuan Zhang, Yuheng Wu, Mingyang Zhao, Zhiwei Chen, Rebecca Li, Fei Zhu, Haohan Zhao, Xiaohua Yuan, Meng Yang, Chunli Qiu, Xiang Cong, Haiyan Chen, Lina Luan, Randolph H.L. The inherent safety and versatility of ultrasound imaging have made it widely accessible in modern clinical settings for disease diagnosis and health management. Artificial intelligence (AI) that can effectively learn ultrasound representations by integrating multi-source data holds significant promise for advancing clinical care.

arxiv-2510-26082.title: Beyond the Uncanny Valley: A Mixed-Method Investigation of Anthropomorphism in Protective Responses to Robot Abuse CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI CCS: Computer systems organization-Embedded and cyber-physical systems-Robotics
arxiv-2510-26082.creator: Fan Yang, Lingyao Li, Yaxin Hu, Michael D. Rodgers, Renkai Ma
arxiv-2510-26082.description: Abstract . Robots with anthropomorphic features are increasingly shaping how humans perceive and morally engage with them. Our research investigates how different levels of anthropomorphism influence protective responses to robot abuse, extending the Computers as Social Actors (CASA) and uncanny valley theories into a moral domain.

pmc-11591219.description: Assisted Dying (AD), the ending of a person’s life pre-emptively under a legal criterion is widely debated, both in the United Kingdom (UK) and Ireland. The expectation is often those doctors closest to dying would be both the proponents and facilitators of this action.

pmc-12404451.title: Evaluation of flow control using PID versus fuzzy logic in an electropneumatic circuit for pulmonary ventilation applications
pmc-12404451.creator: Lina González, Issa Griffith, Alfredo Lescher, Jay Molino, Asdrúal Rojas, Damián Quijano, Shady Abdel Aleem, Shady Abdel Aleem, Shady Abdel Aleem
pmc-12404451.description: High-tech mechanical ventilators are engineered to deliver precise and consistent airflow, which is critical for effective respiratory therapy. This study evaluates flow control performance in a custom-built electro-pneumatic ventilator prototype, comparing Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) control with Fuzzy Logic Control (FLC) through real-time experiments on a test-lung platform to assess accuracy and adaptability under dynamic conditions.

pmc-12581059.title: Neonatal glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase activity by gestational age and sex: evidence-based cut-offs for newborn screening in Saudi Arabia
pmc-12581059.creator: Maryam Alkaabi, Abdul Rafiq Khan, Mohammed Al Balwi, Talal Al Harbi, Ibrahim Ali, Saif Alsaif, Kamal Ali
pmc-12581059.description: ObjectiveTo characterise quantitative glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) activity in term and preterm neonates, compare activity by gestational age (GA) and sex and derive neonatal screening cut-offs using percentile and WHO methods.DesignRetrospective cross-sectional analysis of cord blood screening programme.SettingKing Abdulaziz Medical City, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, January 2016 to May 2022.ParticipantsAll live births with cord blood G6PD and GA.

pmc-12608488.title: Development of Photo-Active Chitosan-Based Films with Riboflavin for Enhanced Antimicrobial Food Packaging Applications
pmc-12608488.creator: Jessica Genovese, Daniele Maria Martins, Tiziana Silvetti, Milena Brasca, Daniela Fracassetti, Gigliola Borgonovo, Stefania Mazzini, Sara Limbo
pmc-12608488.description: This study reports the development of chitosan-based (CS) films incorporating riboflavin (RF) as a natural photosensitizer to create sustainable, light-activated antimicrobial packaging materials. The films were prepared by solvent casting, and their photochemical behavior under blue LED light (450 nm) was investigated, including RF photodegradation kinetics and structural changes in the film-forming solution analyzed by 1H NMR spectroscopy.

pmc-13028272.title: Adaptive Logit Fusion for Mitigating Class Imbalance in Multi-Category Sperm Morphology Assessment
pmc-13028272.creator: Emin Can Özge, Hamza Osman Ilhan, Gorkem Serbes, Hakkı Uzun, Ali Can Karaca, Merve Huner Yigit
pmc-13028272.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Sperm morphology is one of the most critical indicators of male fertility. This paper presents a deep learning-based approach to classify sperm cells into 18 morphological classes, including one normal and 17 abnormal types. Two state-of-the-art convolutional neural networks, EfficientNetV2-S and ResNet50V2, are employed and fine-tuned using a class-weighted loss function together with extensive data augmentation to improve generalization under class imbalance. Automatic mixed precision training is adopted to reduce memory consumption and accelerate the training process.

pmc-13065947.title: Establishing reference values for aortic dimensions in the general Indian population and implications for global standards
pmc-13065947.creator: Mohammed Idhrees, Nora Bacour, Onur Dolmaci, Jedidiah Samraj, Bashi Velayudhan, Nimrat Grewal
pmc-13065947.description: BackgroundThe dimensions of the aorta play a crucial role in cardiovascular health, serving as a determinant of normalcy and a marker for pathological conditions such as aortic aneurysms and dissections. Extensive research has been conducted on the ascending aortic dimensions in the Western population, which forms the basis of the current aortic surgical guidelines.

pmc-13101292.title: Implementation of surface-guided radiotherapy for motion management in liver SBRT: A scoping review and clinical workflow development
pmc-13101292.creator: Orla McKivitt, Michael Roche, Kate Lawless, Paul Collins, Christopher Walker, Aoife O’Connell, Triona O’Donovan, Sean M O’Cathail, Louise Codd, Eoin McGrath, Ines Nobre Gois, Jake Murphy, Aisling Barry
pmc-13101292.description: Highlights•Effective motion management is essential in developing a liver SBRT treatment protocol, particularly to enable the use of small PTV margins.•Motion management strategies include compression, ABC, and RPM, but SGRT use in this group is underreported.•This study demonstrates that SGRT can provide a non-invasive, patient-centred approach to motion management for liver SBRT.

pmc-13241301.title: Assessment of Noninvasive Ear Molding: A Classification‐Guided Approach
pmc-13241301.creator: Lanzhen Cui, Xiaoming Li, Yongqing Zhou, Cong Xu, Kun Chen, Jing Xu, Sumin Li, Li Li, Baojiao Lu, Yingfen Wei, Qi Song
pmc-13241301.description: ObjectiveTo systematically evaluate the clinical application and long‐term efficacy of ear molding devices and to explore future treatment strategies for auricular morphological deformity (AMD).MethodsClinical data of patients with AMDs who visited our department between 2017 and 2022 were retrospectively collected. This study included 102 cases who underwent noninvasive ear molding correction and were followed up for more than 3 years.

pmc-13406636.title: Prodigiosin Enhanced TMZ Chemosensitivity by Suppressing Focal Adhesion and Inhibiting Autophagy in Glioblastoma Cells
pmc-13406636.creator: Shihui Dai, Xin Liu, Xiangyu Jin, Shaoming Mo, Li Li, Chuan Wang, Yaomei Tian
pmc-13406636.description: Glioblastoma (GBM) remains a lethal brain tumor with poor prognosis and limited therapeutic efficacy from temozolomide (TMZ) treatment. Prodigiosin (PG), a bioactive secondary metabolite, has demonstrated anti-tumor activity across a broad spectrum of tumors. This study aims to investigate the therapeutic potential and mechanism of PG combined with TMZ in treating GBM.

pmc-13466490.title: Navigating a fragmented lifeworld: a phenomenological study of schizophrenia among China’s Z Generation
pmc-13466490.creator: Ya-Jing Tang, Lei Yang, Wen-Hao Wang, Chen Zhu, Chuan Shi
pmc-13466490.description: BackgroundThe subjective lived experience of schizophrenia among China’s Z Generation (born 1995–2009) remains understudied. This population navigates a unique socio-cultural context, making their personal narratives crucial for developing effective, person-centered mental health interventions.MethodsWe employed a descriptive phenomenological approach, conducting in-depth interviews with four Chinese Z-generation females diagnosed with schizophrenia.
